questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 1. Falanqee kaalinta culimada Muslimiinta ay ku lahaayeen Cilmiga Jiyoolojiga (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Culimada Muslimiinta sida Al-Biruuni iyo Ibnu Siina waxay qoreen buugaag ku saabsan samaysanka buuraha, dhagaxyada, macdanta iyo dhul-gariirka; Al-Biruuni wuxuu cabbiray cufnaanta macdanta iyo dhagaxyada qaaliga ah; Ibnu Siina wuxuu sharraxay sida buuruhu ugu samaysmaan nabaad-guurka iyo kor u kaca dhulka; Al-Idriisi iyo Al-Mascuudi waxay diiwaangeliyeen muuqaallada dhulka. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 2. Kala saar gobollada dabiiciga ah ee dunida (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Gobollada kulul (inta u dhexeysa 23½°W iyo 23½°K), gobollada dhexdhexaadka ah/qabow-kulul (23½°–66½°), iyo gobollada qabow ee cirifyada (66½°–90°); sidoo kale: kaymaha roobka, savaanaha, lama-degaanka, gobollada Mediterranean-ka, tundra. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 3. Falanqee qaababka wasakhowga hawada. (4 Dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Qiiqa warshadaha iyo gaadiidka; gubashada dhuxusha, shidaalka iyo qashinka; boodhka iyo siigada; kiimikooyinka beeraha (sunta cayayaanka); gaasaska sida CO, SO₂, NO₂ iyo CFC-yada; dhirta oo la gooyo. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 4. Qor xal ku habboon sida looga hortagi karo daadadka.(4dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Dhisidda biyo-xireeno (dams) iyo kaydinta biyaha; dhir-beerid si loo yareeyo qulqulka; hagaajinta iyo qodista webiyada iyo kanaalada; ka fogaanshaha in guryo laga dhiso dhulka daadadku galaan; nidaam digniin hore; dhisidda gidaarro/bangiyo webiga. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 5. Falanqee ahmiyadda istiraajiyadeed ee dhulka Soomaaliyeed.(4dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Soomaaliya waxay leedahay xeebta ugu dheer Afrika (≈3,333 km); waxay ku taal Geeska Afrika oo ku dhow marinka Baab-el-Mandab iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, kuwaas oo maraan maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamka (Badda Cas–Kanaalka Suweys); waxay isku xirtaa Afrika, Bariga Dhexe iyo Aasiya; waxay leedahay khayraad badeed iyo shidaal la filayo. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 6. Falanqee sida ay dadka soomaaliyeed ugu kala baahsanyihiin dalka soomaaliyeed (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Dadku si isku mid ah uguma baahsana: waxay ku badan yihiin magaalooyinka waaweyn (Muqdisho, Hargeysa, Kismaayo, Boosaaso) iyo inta u dhexeysa webiyada Shabeelle iyo Jubba oo beeraha leh; waxay ku yar yihiin dhulka engegan ee waqooyi-bari iyo badhtamaha; sababaha: roobka, biyaha, carrada, nabadda iyo shaqada. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 7. Sharrax kooban ka bixi noocyada gaadiidka dhulka (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Gaadiidka waddooyinka (baabuurta, basaska, gawaarida xamuulka); tareenka (jidka birta); gaadiidka xayawaanka (geel, dameer); tuubooyinka (shidaalka, biyaha); iyo lugeynta. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 8. Tax ilaha daraaseynta bulshooyinka (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Tirakoobka dadka (census); diiwaangelinta muhiimka ah (dhalashada, dhimashada, guurka); sahamin/daraasado muunad ah (surveys); diiwaannada dowladda iyo hay'adaha; wareysiyo iyo indha-indheyn. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 9. Qor caqabadaha haysta xoolo dhaqashada Soomaaliya (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Abaaraha iyo biyo-yarida; cudurrada xoolaha iyo daryeel caafimaad la'aanta; daaq-xumada iyo dhul-daaqsimeedka oo xumaaday; suuq la'aan iyo xayiraadaha dhoofinta; colaadaha iyo amni-darrada. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 10. Kala sooc noocyada xoolo dhaqashada dunida (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Xoolo-dhaqashada reer guuraaga (nomadic pastoralism); xoolo-dhaqashada ganacsiga (commercial ranching); xoolo-dhaqashada caanaha (dairy farming); xoolo-dhaqashada isku-dhafka ah (mixed farming); xoolo-dhaqashada xeroodka (intensive). [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 11. Maxay ku kala duwanyihiin dawladaha badda leh iyo kuwa aan badda laheyn (3 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Dawladaha badda leh waxay leeyihiin dekado, ganacsi badeed, kalluumaysi iyo dalxiis xeebeed; kuwa aan badda lahayn (landlocked) waxay ku tiirsan yihiin dekadaha dalalka deriska ah, kharashka gaadiidka iyo dhoofintana wuu ku badan yahay. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 12. Maxay kula tahay in ay dhacayaan haddii uu kordho kululaanshaha dunida? (4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Barafka cirifyada oo dhalaala iyo heerka badda oo kor u kaca (xeebaha oo daadad galaan); abaaro iyo daadad badan; isbeddel cimilo iyo roob la'aan; dhimashada dhirta iyo xayawaanka; cudurro iyo cunto-yari. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 13. Isbarbardhig waxa ay ku kala duwan yihiin Cimilo iyo Cimilogooreed? ( 4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Cimilada (climate) waa celceliska xaaladda hawada ee meel muddo dheer (30 sano ama ka badan); cimilo-gooreedka (weather) waa xaaladda hawada ee meel waqti gaaban (maalin/saacado) sida heerkulka, roobka iyo dabaysha. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]

questions.section: QAYBTA 2AAD EE IMTIXAANKA – T. Ka jawaab Su'aalahaan (60 Dhibcood)
questions.question: 14. Qor xal ku habboon saameynta xun ee warshaduhu ku leeyihiin deegaanka ( 4 dhibcood)
questions.answer_guide: Shaandheynta (filter) qiiqa warshadaha; daaweynta biyaha wasakhaysan ka hor inta aan la sii deyn; dib-u-isticmaalka qashinka (recycling); isticmaalka tamarta nadiifka ah; sharciyo deegaan oo la dhaqangeliyo; dhir-beerid; in warshadaha laga fogeeyo goobaha la deggan yahay. [Fiiro: jawaab-tusaale ah – macallinku ha xaqiijiyo.]
